remediation_design: GOVERNED ACTION/PLUGIN REGISTRY (design only; no code changed): LLM output NEVER executes as code. Model proposes structured {action_type, parameters}; flow = (1) JSON-schema validation of the proposal; (2) Action Registry lookup — action_type must be a REGISTERED handler; unregistered => UNKNOWN_ACTION refusal (this is the dynamic-handler replacement: no generated Python, ever); (3) action_type -> capability_resolver.resolve_capability -> CanonicalCapability (unknown/ambiguous/dormant/disabled/generation-mismatch => REFUSED pre-contact); (4) authority: DelegationAuthority.issue with approval binding validated by AuthorityApprovalService (mission/actor/tenant/capability/resource binding, expiry, exactly-once); (5) registered handler executes with capability-scoped params; (6) MissionReceipt + evidence. Skill execution (skill_evolution) migrates to the same registry: skills become declarative action bundles, not exec'd code; if raw-code skills are retained they must run in a process-isolated sandbox (subprocess/container, no shared globals) with the same capability+authority pre-gate and a written permission manifest per skill.
